summary: Axon Enterprise filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a second amendment to its December 15, 2022 credit agreement plus a concurrent offering of 0% Convertible Notes due 2031. The amendment lifts the revolver from $300 million to $500 million, with a $150 million accordion, and extends maturity to September 18, 2031, conditioned on the notes offering closing. JPMorgan Chase acts as administrative agent, with J.P. Morgan Securities as sole bookrunner. Watch the convertible's strike, preliminary conversion mechanics, the March 2031 optional repurchase and share-settlement trigger below $350, and any delta-hedge overhang.
